dct_description_sm:
This dataset represents the results of a community led planning process to sustain the natural environment across the landscape. A collaborative team of individuals representing governments, stewardship councils, conservation organizations and private landowners worked together to identify and map natural heritage features and the connections between them. The data package includes:
  • spatial data
  • project reports
  • presentation materials
The data has been made available to inform and support:
  • land use planning and resource management decision-making
  • strategic priorities for stewardship and restoration projects
  • priorities for conservation land acquisitions
  • priorities for inventory programs and research projects

Status
Completed: Production of the data has been completed

Maintenance and Update Frequency
Not planned: There are no plans to update the data

dct_title_s: Sustaining what we value: A natural heritage system for the Frontenac, Lanark, Leeds & Grenville area of eastern Ontario
